newsitem.title: FINLAND: S&P, MOODY'S TO VISIT FINLAND IN NOVEMBER - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: S&P, MOODY'S TO VISIT FINLAND IN NOVEMBER - PAPER.

text.p: U.S. credit rating institutes Standard & Poors and Moody's will visit Finland in November and there are hopes that Finland's ratings may rise, daily Helsingin Sanomat reported on Thursday.
It quoted the finance ministry's finance director Kari Nars as saying that Finland has a good story to tell the institutes and that the Finnish economy has changed since their previous visits.
Standard & Poor's rating for Finnish long term foreign currency loans is AA- and the institute changed the outlook to positive from stable in August 1995.
Moody's rates Finnish long-term currency debt Aa2. This has been unchanged since January 1992.
